text: Day three. The council met on the quay at noon, because Dunn liked an audience.
Gus had no proof. He had a story about a door, and a cat who would not go near it.
Then, at twelve o’clock exactly, in full sun… the lamp went out.
Every head on the quay turned to the tower. Every head but one.
On the north rocks stood the yellow coat. Facing away from the lighthouse. Facing the quay. Facing Gus.
